notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value eight or greater.
Illuminor Szeras does not have summoning sickness.
Umbral Mantle attached to Illuminor Szeras.
description:
Activate Illuminor Szeras by tapping it and sacrificing another creature with mana value eight or greater, adding at least eight {B}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Activate Illuminor Szeras by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
